capabilities: temporarily remove editor focus after a Markdown file opens to hide the cursor
restore focus and place the cursor at the first line when ArrowDown is pressed
extras: The ArrowDown trigger is one-time per file open/switch and is ignored during the ~500 ms defocus window; the README also includes local development setup requiring NodeJS 16+.
problem: When Obsidian opens a file it automatically places the cursor on the first line and enters editing mode, which affects how the first line is displayed.
summary: Defocuses the editor when a note opens so the cursor is hidden and the first line's styling is unaffected until you press ArrowDown to edit.
